RECONCILED. The eighteen extern-declaration conflicts above are all cases where two shards spelled the same external symbol differently -- a parameter list written out long-hand in one and terse in the other, or a data global declared u8 in one and s8 in the next. The promoted TU carries one spelling per symbol, chosen as tubuild chose it, and the alternates are deleted rather than left commented out. The proof that the kept set is admissible is the round itself: the TU compiles under the pinned 2004 b56 and all nineteen functions byte-match with every relocation destination verified, which no wrong spelling of a called function or a read global survives. The four local 'struct dMeter_c' conflicts needed no choice at all -- each was a shard's private stand-in for the class, and all four are superseded by include/dMeter_c.h.

CLASS IDENTITY IS THE CARTRIDGE'S OWN, and the earlier note claiming otherwise was wrong. _ZTS8dMeter_c at ov002:0x0210c218 holds the literal bytes '8dMeter_c' and a NUL -- ten bytes, exactly what the mangled spelling _ZTS8dMeter_c requires (one digit of length prefix, eight characters of name, one NUL), and exactly the size the compiler emits. _ZTI8dMeter_c at 0x0210c224 is a three-word __si_class_type_info: word 0 is _ZTVN3abi20__si_class_type_infoE (arm9 0x0209a764), word 1 points at that type-name string, and word 2 is _ZTI7dBase_c (arm9 0x02086e78), so the ROM names both the class and its base. The vtable header at 0x0210c2c0 points its typeinfo word back at 0x0210c224. Nothing here is coined, and no rename is needed before promotion.

This TU is dMeter_c's key-function TU. The destructor is inline in include/dMeter_c.h, so the key function is InitResources, the first virtual the class leaves out of line, and the object emits _ZTV8dMeter_c (0x50 including the two-word preamble) plus the _ZTI and _ZTS records for dMeter_c, dBase_c and fBase_c into .data. 'sections' stays .text-only and those seven symbols are licensed as deadstrip-data at their measured cartridge homes. Range-licensing the data is not available here: the cartridge puts g_profile_METER at 0x0210c210 immediately below the typeinfo pair at 0x0210c218, and four unnamed sprite tables between that pair and the vtable storage at 0x0210c2c0, so it would take two disjoint intervals around a third owner. Same disposition as the landed ov064 daBDonketu_c.

MEMBER AND FIELD RECONSTRUCTION. include/dMeter_c.h did not declare four of this TU's nineteen members -- RenderLifeCount, RenderCameraButtons, RenderCoinCount and UpdateVsTimer -- and the shards therefore spelled them as hand-mangled extern "C" free functions taking the object as an explicit first parameter. This promotion declares all four in the class and defines them as ordinary members; the ABI is unchanged (the object still arrives in r0) and all four still byte-match. The offset casts the shards used to reach this object's fields are now field names: 0x06e and 0x078 are newly named mLifeCountX and mStarCountSlideIn, with the evidence recorded beside each declaration, and naming 0x078 exposed an off-by-one in the header's tail padding that pad_077 now corrects. The English member and field names remain Tier B reconstructions. 0x062, 0x064 and 0x072 are written once by InitResources and never read back inside this TU, so they earn no name and their three stores stay offset writes.
